Task 27637_0 then reproduced all six historical trace leaves exactly but exposed an inconsistent false aggregate predicate before analytic inference/rollout (failure SHA 51d4c2...); ADR-0025 binds the replacement gate to the exact reported evidence. Allocation-backed smoke and the 17-case comparison remain pending; no probe training is permitted while this gate is active.
